name: basonuclin zinc finger protein 2

function.text: BNC2 is the approved symbol for basonuclin zinc finger protein 2. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include lower urinary tract obstruction, congenital (autosomal dominant). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; Strong GenCC assertion, Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific review required.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.
